mapper.select: select y.id, y.denglu_zhanghao, y.mima, y.xingming, y.xingbie, y.shouji, y.youxiang, y.touxiang, y.zhuangtai, y.zuihou_denglu_shijian, j.id as juese_id, j.juese_bianma, j.juese_mingcheng, j.miaoshu as juese_miaoshu from xitong_yonghu y left join yonghu_juese yj on y.id = yj.yonghu_id left join xitong_juese j on yj.juese_id = j.id where y.denglu_zhanghao = #{dengluZhanghao}

select y.id, y.denglu_zhanghao, y.mima, y.xingming, y.xingbie, y.shouji, y.youxiang, y.touxiang, y.zhuangtai, y.zuihou_denglu_shijian, j.id as juese_id, j.juese_bianma, j.juese_mingcheng, j.miaoshu as juese_miaoshu from xitong_yonghu y left join yonghu_juese yj on y.id = yj.yonghu_id left join xitong_juese j on yj.juese_id = j.id where y.id = #{id}
